title: Cape Verde hero Vozinha on newfound fame
summary: Cape Verde's World Cup star Vozinha has experienced sudden fame following his performances. The player now yearns for the peaceful lifestyle he had before achieving international prominence. His comments reflect the personal toll that sudden celebrity can take on athletes.
content: Cape Verde's World Cup hero Vozinha says he craves the "peace and tranquillity" of the life he led before he shot to fame.
